model.title: Legislative Branch Agencies Clarification Act
model.meta: Oversight and Government Reform Committee, Judiciary Committee, House Administration · Rep. H. Griffith (R-VA)

summary.text: The bill would change how the Librarian of Congress, the Director of the Government Publishing Office, and the Register of Copyrights are appointed and removed, with the first two chosen by a bipartisan congressional commission rather than by the President and Senate and removable only by a majority vote of the congressional majority and minority leaders. It would also move supervisory power over the Copyright Office from the Library of Congress to the Register of Copyrights, require the Register to be a U.S. citizen with copyright law background who is appointed by the President with Senate consent for a 10-year term, and create an Inspector General office within the Copyright Office. Finally, it would require the Government Publishing Office to set up and maintain a human capital management system.
